core-kind: Both members are the closed view-module enums core-status-pattern already teaches: same derives, same serde rename, same parse/classify contract.
core-state: Only SpecState fits (SegmentState is an enum covered by core-status-pattern), so there is a single exemplar and no recurring shape in a folder already covered by core-view-pattern.
dashboard-source: Same paths as dashboard-kind-pattern (src/lib/types/**); the only real *Source declaration is SavingsSource, and the serde-mirror union convention is taught there.
dashboard-summary: Same folder and role as dashboard-use-pattern; useEconomySummary.ts is already an exemplar there and Summary is a domain noun with no shape left to teach.
dashboard-wave: WaveCost/WaveChild/SpecWave share a domain noun, not a shape; structurally they are serde-mirror DTOs already covered by dashboard-kind-pattern.
rt-file: No shared shape between the two members: only diff_digest.rs declares a *File type; wave_done.rs File hits are prose in a ## Files section.
rt-src: Folder-name cluster, not a role: exemplars are crate-root wiring whose rules already live in apps/rt/CLAUDE.md Guards, and its apps/rt/src/** paths would load on top of every other rt mold.
